issues.issue: Whether the risk account (sacrifice threats, timing and details) is credible
issues.applicant_position: Inconsistency about the risk source was peripheral; RPD applied a memory test and misread her testimony.
issues.respondent_position: Counsel says testimony was not inconsistent and the threats are explained in the narrative.
issues.result_text: RPD erred on some factors but its credibility concerns suffice to rebut the presumption of truthfulness.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in finding the timing of threats after arrival suspicious
issues.result_text: Timing alone cannot ground a negative finding, but here it was one of several concerns, so no error.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD properly gave little weight to the documents, emails and affidavits
issues.respondent_position: Counsel argues RPD erred in giving little weight to documents about the alleged assault and some medical reports.
issues.result_text: Document irregularities and the omission of the family killing justify little weight; no error.

issues.issue: Whether the psychological report explains the memory and inconsistency problems
issues.respondent_position: Counsel argues the psychological state affected testimony and memory and the report was wrongly discounted.
issues.result_text: Report does not establish that the inconsistencies relate to psychological issues; it was properly discounted.

issues.issue: Whether a viable internal flight alternative exists in Abuja or Enugu
issues.applicant_position: BVN tracking, indigeneity, single-woman status and ethnic discrimination make relocation unreasonable.
issues.result_text: RPD's IFA finding is well supported; challenges to relocation are not significant enough to jeopardize safety.
